pages.title: A Small Favor
pages.text: Once the Hunger's eyes have opened upon you, its attention starts to mean something more. Every so often, as your Faith grows, it presses a Token of the Hunger into your thoughts - and with it, a choice between two gifts.

pages.title: Right-Click to Accept
pages.text: Choose the Boon from the token's offering, and a right-click consumes it - permanently lengthening how long the good the Hunger does for you actually lasts.
